title: Write Multiple Registers with compact payload and length-sensitive shape
purpose: Explore a conservative FC16 request whose declared MBAP length and internal byte count are self-consistent, targeting stream and length-processing logic with a recognizable multi-register write rather than reproducing a documented collision payload.
expected_behavior: The target should parse a valid Write Multiple Registers request for two registers and either acknowledge the write range or return a protocol-level exception if the address is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000B matches unit identifier plus 10-byte FC16 PDU
Function code 10 includes address, quantity, byte count, and payload fields
Quantity two matches byte count 04 and provided register data length
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe length-handling analogue only. It intentionally avoids the exact documented FC16 bytes associated with historical stream-length behavior and introduces no trailing surplus bytes.
